title: prefs, recent, filter files: Sanitize user inputs for newlines
description:
When writing to files that are read back in a line at a time,
sanitize strings to remove newlines.

Fix: #21019

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 03218da7 - prefs, recent, filter files: Sanitize user inputs for newlines
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23628/diffs?diff_id=1670158494&start_sha=41f781e0202223c715d58d096f2627835dc75888)
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 3

FYI, `G_REGEX_MATCH_DEFAULT` is new in GLib 2.74, which means that this commit makes Wireshark no longer build on Ubuntu 22.04:

https://github.com/wireshark/wireshark/actions/runs/22780200869/job/66083746878

changes_data.diff:
@@ -354,6 +354,17 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC
 char *
 join_string_list(GList *sl);
 
+/** Sanitize a string so that it can be written to a preference file.
+ *
+ * The preference file format (along with some other Wireshark file formats)
+ * expects one entry per line. This takes a string, which may come from user
+ * input, and converts line terminators (along with adjacent whitespace) into
+ * a single space.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC
+char *
+prefs_sanitize_string(const char* str);
+
 #ifdef __cplusplus
 }
 #endif /* __cplusplus */

@@ -197,6 +197,17 @@ QUuid e_guid_t_to_quuid(const struct _e_guid_t &guid);
  */
 QString html_escape(const QString plain_string);
 
+/** Remove line terminators from a string. Similar to QString::simplified,
+ * but does not remove long stretches of spaces or tabs where no newline
+ * or carriage return is present.
+ *
+ * @param multiline_string String to sanitize.
+ *
+ * @return A QString with line terminators (and whitespace before and after)
+ * replaced with a single space.
+*/
+QString join_lines(const QString multiline_string);
+
